description:
About our brand and products: Inspiriko is a UK-based, woman-owned wellness brand creating science-backed supplements designed specifically for women's health. Our range covers hormonal health, sleep and mood, digestive health, joint and bone health, skin/hair/nails, and intimate health, with bestsellers including our Multi Collagen Powder and Capsules, Triple Magnesium Complex, Organic Black Seed Oil, and Fibre Complex. All formulas are vegan and made in the UK to high manufacturing standards.

What makes us different: We're formulated for women, by women — every product is built around research-backed ingredients rather than trend-driven marketing. Customers can take a short quiz to get matched with the right supplements for their life stage, and our Subscribe & Save program (30% off recurring orders) drives strong repeat purchase rates, meaning affiliates benefit from a loyal, high-retention customer base rather than one-off sales.

How affiliates can earn: Affiliates earn an 18% commission on every sale generated through their unique link or coupon code, with a 30-day cookie window so you still get credit if a customer converts a few weeks later. Payouts are made via PayPal or debit card, and applications go through a quick manual review to keep the program quality-focused.

How to promote us: Share your affiliate link or personal discount code through product reviews, wellness/health content, social media posts and stories, email newsletters, or blog content. Our best-performing partners tend to be creators and publishers focused on women's health, natural wellness, menopause/hormonal support, skincare, or gut health — real testimonials and before/after style content tend to convert especially well with our audience.

Other information: Inspiriko primarily serves women aged 25–64+ in the UK. Relevant hashtags/topics: #inspiriko #multicollagen #hydrolizedcollagen #womenshealth #wellness. We're happy to provide creative assets, product samples, or answer questions directly through the affiliate chat for partners who want to promote us seriously.
